content.problemStatement: Write a program for the coding challenge "Zookeeper and The Infinite Zoo". Refer to LeetCode description: https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1491/D
content.inputFormat: The first line contains an integer T, the number of test cases. Then T test cases follow. The first line of each test case contains two integers n and k. The second line contains n integers a1, a2, ..., an.
content.outputFormat: For each test case, print the minimum number of operations required to make all elements of the array equal.

solution.approach: To solve this problem, we can use the concept of median. We need to find the median of the array and then calculate the minimum number of operations required to make all elements equal to the median.

code.Python3:
import sys
for _ in range(int(input())):
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
    arr.sort()
    median = arr[n // 2]
    count = sum(abs(x - median) for x in arr)
    print(count)
